name: Perth Hills
terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A region in the Greater Perth zone of Western Australia. Shiraz is 37 percent of plantings, with Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay at 11 percent each.
